problem: "楼上那层明天会好" says the floor will get better; it is the light that gets fixed.
suggested_fix: 我知道，我打过电话，楼上那{M}的灯明天会修好。

problem: "最后一系列的事" / "最后一系列" is not a natural use of 系列 (一系列 is a set phrase "a series of").
suggested_fix: 最后那{M}的内容，你还记得多少？

problem: "最后一系列给我的印象最深" same problem with 最后一系列.
suggested_fix: 记得，最后那{M}给我的印象最深。

problem: "one lovely strand of smell" is not English (slot gloss "strand" leaks).
suggested_fix: Do you notice a lovely smell in the kitchen?

problem: "this strand of smell" is not English.
suggested_fix: Yes, that smell seems to come from outside.

problem: "This strand of smell makes me hungrier" is not English.
suggested_fix: This smell is making me hungrier, let's go eat.

problem: "只有一公尺" from the hotel (one meter) is absurd; walking/taxi talk and "边走边看风景" make no sense for 1 m.
suggested_fix: 手机上说，我们离酒店只有两百{M}了。

problem: "前面还有一公尺就到了...走了很远...最后一公尺" is absurd for one meter.
suggested_fix: 前面还有两百{M}就到了，再坚持一下。

problem: "Want one piece?" about apples; gloss "piece" leaks (also "this piece" in B and A2).
suggested_fix: The apples are good. Want one?

problem: "I want to buy a big piece" - gloss "piece" leaks; Chinese is "a big one" (also "this piece"/"that piece" in B and A2).
suggested_fix: I want to buy a big one.

problem: "next issue of this event" is not English for an event; 期 here is an edition/session (also B "this issue was great").
suggested_fix: Will you come to the next one of these events too?

problem: "I watch every issue" - issues are read, not watched; wrong noun for the context (B "latest issue", A2 "first issue").
suggested_fix: I watch every episode. What about you?

problem: "every issue of this show" is not English; a show has episodes (also B "first issue", A2 "next issue").
suggested_fix: I watch every episode of this show. What about you?

problem: "borrow one stick" / "this stick" for a pen: slot gloss "stick" leaks into the English.
suggested_fix: I forgot my pen. Can I borrow one?

problem: "one piece of business" / "this piece of business" is not natural English for 一件事.
suggested_fix: There's something I want to talk to you about.

problem: "one sheet of map" / "this sheet of map" is not English.
suggested_fix: I drew you a map, take it.

problem: "Which item did you like best in this competition?" - "item" is wrong; these are events.
suggested_fix: Which event did you like best in this competition?

problem: 嗯哼 is used as a hesitation filler stacked after another interjection ("哦，嗯哼，...") at the start of statements; unnatural (嗯哼 is a reply sound).
嗯哼 stacked after 哇/诶 as a statement opener is unnatural.
嗯哼 stacked after 诶/哈哈/哦 as an opener is unnatural, and "让他们听到我们的嗯哼" style repetition adds nothing.
Prompts use gloss as a verb: "she should don't worry", "Tell him to 'don't worry'", "if she says 'don't worry'".
suggested_fix: Tell her that she is leaving on her own tomorrow, so she can rest assured about things at home.

problem: Prompts: "she should don't worry and buy them", "she should don't worry".
suggested_fix: Say the clothes there do not shrink, so she can buy them with confidence.

problem: 例如 does not fit: "我想去北京，例如长城", "好玩，例如长城", "我先看飞机票，例如十月" - not examples of a category.
"天气这么好，例如去游泳" - 例如 does not introduce an example; reads wrongly.
"游泳有点冷，例如我们去公园走走吧" - 例如 is wrong (needs 不如/那).
suggested_fix: 游泳有点冷，我们去公园走走吧。

problem: "我不太同意这个办法，就是说，你觉得没有问题？" - 就是说 does not restate anything; A's disagreement and the question to B do not follow.
suggested_fix: 你觉得没有问题，{W}，你同意这个办法？

problem: A said the phone is black, yet B asks what colour it is and A then says it is white - lines contradict each other.
suggested_fix: 没有，{W}，你的手机是什么牌子的？我帮你找。

problem: A2 "是白色的" contradicts A1 "一个黑色的手机".
suggested_fix: 是黑色的，{W}，你能帮我打一下这个电话吗？我手机坏了。

problem: A2 "I thought you had left yesterday" contradicts A1, where they were supposed to travel today.
suggested_fix: {W}，我还以为你们一早就已经出发了。

problem: "不用给我看菜单了" is a non sequitur after they have finished ordering and want to pay.
suggested_fix: 对，{W}点了，我们走吧。

problem: English "more and more warm" is not natural (warmer and warmer).
A1 says the results are already out, but A2 says "when the results come out".
suggested_fix: 别太{W}，我们一起看吧。

problem: A declares being really dissatisfied right after proposing to meet him first; contradictory.
suggested_fix: 那明天一起去认识他吧，也许是我太{W}了。

problem: English "feel/felt pleasant" is not natural (have a pleasant time).
English "more sweet" is not natural (sweeter).
suggested_fix: Yeah, it's sweeter than last time's.

problem: English "the most sweet one" is not natural (the sweetest).
suggested_fix: Okay, you're treating, so I want the sweetest one!

problem: English "more sweet / way more sweet" is not natural (sweeter).
English "a bit more light" is not natural (lighter).
English "eat more light" is not natural (eat lighter).
suggested_fix: Really? I'd like to eat lighter too. It's good for you.

problem: English "a bit more light" is not natural (lighter).
suggested_fix: I got used to it slowly. Now lighter food tastes good to me too.

problem: English "a bit more spicy" is not natural (spicier).
suggested_fix: I got used to it slowly. Now spicier food tastes good to me too.

problem: 'What way do you use to make this dish?' is not natural English
suggested_fix: What method do you use to make this dish?

problem: '继续那个理想' is not a collocation
suggested_fix: 后来呢？你为什么没有坚持那个{W}？

problem: Missing article/plural: 'great that you have dream'
suggested_fix: It's great that you have {a} {E}. I still don't know what I want to do.

problem: Plural missing: 'We have two plan'
suggested_fix: We have two {Es}. Which one do you prefer?

problem: 'scenes of military' is ungrammatical English
suggested_fix: The movies kids watch have too many military scenes.

problem: 'scenes of military' is ungrammatical English
suggested_fix: I agree. Kids shouldn't see too many military scenes.

problem: 'scenes of military' is ungrammatical English
suggested_fix: Right, let's pick another movie with fewer military scenes.

problem: '我也不懂问题' is not grammatical (needs 这个问题)
suggested_fix: 我也不懂这个{W}。

problem: '我来得太慢了' is not how one says 'I'm late'
suggested_fix: 对不起，我来晚了，路上遇到了{W}。

problem: Prompt "after she sleep" is ungrammatical
suggested_fix: Say health comes first, and she'll feel much better after she sleeps.

problem: Prompt "while she charge" is ungrammatical
suggested_fix: Suggest she rests and listens to music while she charges it.

problem: Prompt "after she sleep" is ungrammatical
suggested_fix: Say OK, but after she sleeps, no more phone.

problem: Prompt "whether she still cover up" is ungrammatical
suggested_fix: Ask her whether she still covers up with a quilt when she sleeps in this heat.

problem: Prompt "how she usually relax" is ungrammatical
suggested_fix: Ask her how she usually relaxes on weekends.

problem: Prompt "where she usually take photos" is ungrammatical
suggested_fix: Ask her where she usually takes photos.

problem: Prompt "Ask her where she live now" is ungrammatical
suggested_fix: Ask her where she lives now.

problem: Prompt "since he has so many relatives to visit relatives" is garbled by the slot gloss
suggested_fix: Ask if a week is enough, since he has so many relatives to see.

problem: '没有关系' reads as 'it doesn't matter'; ambiguous/misleading here
suggested_fix: 没有好{W}，孩子不开心。

problem: '没有相信' is wrong; needs 信任
suggested_fix: 有道理，没有信任，很难保持{W}。

problem: A1 asks about 这个办法 (a method) but A2 says 我也买一个试试 (buy one) - incoherent; the item should be a product
suggested_fix: A1: 这个东西的{W}怎么样？你有没有用过？

problem: 水准 'increases' is wrong; 水准 goes up (提高)

problem: 水准 'increases' is wrong; use 提高

problem: 水准 'increases' is wrong; use 提高

problem: B talks to a man but the prompt says "she should ask the waiter again".

problem: "下个周" is not natural; 周 does not take 个 (say 下周 / 下个星期).
suggested_fix: 下{W}你有什么打算？ / 下{W}我想去旅行，你呢？ / 下{W}我也想出去，我们一起走吧。

problem: "这个周" is not natural; 周 does not take 个 (say 这周 / 这个星期).
suggested_fix: 这{W}你那儿的天气怎么样？ / 这{W}常常下雨，你要带伞。 / 好，我这{W}都带伞。

problem: "这个周" is not natural; 周 does not take 个 (say 这周).
suggested_fix: 你这{W}忙不忙？ / 很忙，这{W}我要加班。 / 辛苦了，这{W}过去就好了。

problem: B prompt says "she can pay by scanning the QR code", but the listener A is a man.
suggested_fix: Say yes, he can pay by scanning the QR code.

problem: "什么颜色的一双鞋" is not a natural construction (measure phrase after 的).

problem: "I could never do the worker's job" and "the worker really matters" are unnatural English (singular generic).

problem: English singular "the laborer's income", "care more about the laborer" is unnatural (should be laborers).

problem: "你问人吧" is not natural Chinese (bare 人 as the one to ask).
suggested_fix: 不知道，你问问那个{W}吧。

problem: "人应该知道" is not natural without a determiner.

problem: Prompt says "where he is going to work" but the line asks where he works
suggested_fix: Ask her where he works.

problem: Prompt is ungrammatical ("they usually be open").

problem: English "I'm always out of money before I get married" is the wrong tense and illogical for 我结婚以前总是没有钱 (past habit).

problem: "坏的事" is not natural; Chinese says 坏消息.

problem: "这辆车很多钱" is not correct Chinese (should be 很贵 / 要很多钱).

problem: "any good itinerary" is ungrammatical (singular countable without article).

problem: Prompt ungrammatical: 'her hair really are different'

problem: Prompt "if she has apply for the visa" is ungrammatical.
